Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Ryder Industrial Round Coffee Table, 43.3" Diameter, Brushed Natural Antique Copper
Colors: Natural/Gold
Materials: Metal
This industrial round coffee table comes with a natural, antique-copper-finished elm top on an iron base in a brass finish. The open base keeps the table lightweight and gives the room an airy feel. This piece looks great in any contemporary or rustic space. 43.3“ diameter x 16.54"H Elm, metal This industrial coffee table comes with a natural antique-copper-finished elm top and an iron base in a brass finish. The open design of this table's base helps keep it lightweight. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
